_comment: Single source of truth for model choices. Read by agents, tooling and the Phase 2 board scheduler. Model ids must match the section names in models.ini.

kat.desc: KAT-Coder, CPU-offloaded, best at writing and fixing code

bigbang.desc: BigBang, CPU-offloaded, orchestration/research/review, pinned main model

bonsai.desc: Bonsai 1-bit, fits in VRAM, 4-way parallel, good only on short chains

assignment._comment: Complexity 1..10 decides who runs a task. The philosophy is to keep scores low by splitting: a high score means the task is not ready to run, not that a big model should attempt it.
assignment._review: A finished task waits in Review until a DIFFERENT model verifies it by running tests. Order is tried top to bottom; the first model that is not the one that did the work wins. Dependents only unblock on a PASS, so with this disabled the board stops after the first card until you press Mark done.
